description: This file defines the MAX_Dal_Admin_Affiliates class, which manages database interactions related to affiliates, including retrieving affiliates by keyword, fetching websites and zones by agency ID, and getting publishers by tracker ID.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Admin_Affiliates
classes.description: Data access layer class for managing affiliate-related database operations in the admin context.

methods.name: getAffiliateByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves affiliates matching a keyword, optionally filtered by agency ID.

methods.name: getWebsitesAndZonesByAgencyId
methods.description: Fetches websites and their associated zones for a given agency ID, with ordering options.

methods.name: getPublishersByTracker
methods.description: Retrieves publishers associated with a specific tracker ID.
